decision: No V1-versus-Dusk winner is supportable from the current scoped artifacts.

valid_evidence.scope_note: These facts validate the reconstructed V1 history; they do not validate a Dusk comparison.

invalid_dusk_candidate.selection_basis: Only sampled profile among 32 diagnostic candidates that initialized the selected historical markets; not program defaults and not a calibrated/frozen winner.
invalid_dusk_candidate.grain_warning: Replay status counts cover the five-market input history while the published projection filtered score rows to three markets.

program_defaults_baseline.interpretation: The checked-in defaults are a prospective code baseline, not a deployed configuration. They cannot currently replay this retained history to completion.

questions.question: Collateral efficiency
questions.why: The published values were sums across repeated borrow observations, not debt-to-collateral efficiency ratios; the Dusk candidate was incomplete and unscored.
questions.required_next_evidence: A complete named or frozen profile plus paired debt/collateral, filled-demand, and unmet-demand metrics at the same checkpoints.

questions.question: Spot capital efficiency
questions.why: The sampled Dusk candidate produced no comparable execution-cost or slippage observations, so its near-zero revenue is mostly rejected historical flow, not venue economics.
questions.required_next_evidence: Paired executed swaps and standardized probes with output, cost, slippage, equivalent depth, fee return, and capital utilization.

questions.question: Leverage
questions.why: No frozen leverage campaign was executed; projected debt observation-sums are not leverage or maintenance-margin results.
questions.required_next_evidence: The exact leverage grid with opening/unwind costs, executable leverage, margin buffers, funding, adverse paths, and liquidation outcomes.

questions.question: LP and protocol economics
questions.why: The Dusk replay deferred 77 external-state operations and was incomplete, so raw revenue totals are not comparable venue revenue or yield.
questions.required_next_evidence: A complete replay with capital-time denominators and all revenue lanes separated by origin and accounting class.

requirements: Use a named Dusk baseline or a training-calibrated profile frozen before holdout.
Replay exactly the three selected markets plus required global state without mixing five-market status counts.
Require complete_for_scoring=true, non-null candidate and combined scores, and zero blocking reasons.
Publish only the four preregistered metrics with their correct denominators; otherwise mark the metric unavailable.
